items.reason: Inclusion requires 'glioblastoma or WHO grade 4 astrocytoma, IDH-mutant', and the summary names 'glioblastoma ("GBM") or Grade 4 astrocytoma, IDH-mutant'. Manual §1.1 says IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma is not glioblastoma, so two glioma types are eligible with glioblastoma named: mixed_glioma_gbm_named. The conditions entry 'Glioblastoma, IDH-mutant' supports historical terminology but does not make the population GBM-only.

The only intervention under test is '[RADIATION] Dose escalation + Reduced Margin Adaptive Radiotherapy' (temozolomide is standard concurrent chemoradiation), so the S6 reason is excluded_intervention_type under D31-C1.

note: Passes S5 either way and is excluded at S6 (radiotherapy dose-escalation trial; temozolomide soc_backbone). The S6 reason is now excluded_intervention_type under D31-C1. The population value only affects Figure 1 bookkeeping.

revisions.reason: The record tests only 'Dose escalation + Reduced Margin Adaptive Radiotherapy' on the MR-Linac, a radiotherapy intervention, so C1 requires excluded_intervention_type.
